title: Lüth decision (1958)
summary: Federal Constitutional Court held basic rights have indirect third-party effect via civil law open norms.
principle: Horizontal effect (mittelbare Drittwirkung) of basic rights.

title: Mephisto decision (1971)
summary: Balanced artistic freedom against personality rights in publishing disputes.

title: Lisbon Treaty case (2009)
summary: Bundestag must retain meaningful democratic control over EU integration steps.
principle: Democracy and sovereignty in EU membership.

title: NPD ban proceedings (illustrative party democracy)
summary: Illustrates militant democracy (streitbare Demokratie) limits on anti-constitutional parties.

title: Data retention decisions (telecommunications surveillance)
summary: Repeated constitutional review struck or constrained blanket communications data retention laws.
principle: Privacy of communications and proportionate surveillance.

title: Euro rescue package cases
summary: Bundestag budgetary autonomy limits on transfer union mechanisms under EU crisis responses.
principle: Budgetary constitutional law and EU financial solidarity.
